metadata.title: Christmas Celebrations by the Garo People
metadata.description:
Christmas celebrations in my village like hundreds of small villages scattered across the thick forest of Garo hills, West Khasi hills and Bangladesh is something that I long and look forward to every year. 

I make sure I show up at my village for Christmas and New years, no matter which part of world I had been the whole year. 

Like me many young people who are working in different cities in India and abroad travel back home to be part of it. 

Christmas and New year celebrations are a community affair, where huge pandals which can house an entire village is erected using bamboos and covered with banana leaves. 

Whole village comes together to organize the celebrations. Pigs are butchered for preparing delicious Phura for community lunch. After a brief prayer people have community lunch inside the pandals and following it starts the celebrations. People young and old dance away the night to the beat of drums.
